verdicts.note: G-5: Editorial advice to the writer on composing alt text content, not a checkable textual property.
Actionable check flagging alt text that duplicates information provided in the caption.
Actionable rule prohibiting the use of the deprecated HTML <longdesc> attribute.
G-1: Section heading that groups child rules; A1 marks the child rule.
G-5: High-level accessibility guidance summarizing WCAG fundamentals, not an automated text check.
Specific rule dictating placement of copyright attribution (in the caption or following the material).
G-5: Advice to the writer to follow an external/organisational style guide.
Specific rule requiring null alt text (alt="") for decorative images, distinct from informative images (A1).
G-5: General SEO advice to the writer.
G-4: Restatement of C8 under decorative images, prohibiting keyword text in place of null alt text.
G-5: Vague editorial advice to provide context, already covered formally by A2.
Specific rule for hyperlinked logos, modifying general logo alt text rule A5.
G-5: Authoring guidance on how to present data for complex images.
G-5: Subjective advice left to author discretion ('only if it helps the user').
G-5: Editorial advice giving layout options for extended descriptions based on subjective length.
G-5: Advice to the writer on where to place analytical interpretation.
Actionable rule requiring parallel grammatical structure across titles and captions.
Rule requiring consistent terminology and acronym forms between titles/captions and surrounding text.
G-4: Restates the title numbering format specified in A9 (using a colon after the number to separate it from title text).
Rule requiring figure numbering sequences to commence at the beginning of the document.
G-5: Procedural software instructions for Microsoft Word's cross-reference dialog.
